summary: EditSession<T> only round-trips public read/write properties; doesn't handle fields, get-only collections, base-type properties.
fix: Tightened EditSession<T> XML docs to explicitly scope the helper to flat DTOs with public read/write scalar/enum/string/nullable properties. Get-only collections, computed properties, and fields are documented as out-of-scope. ProductDto fits the supported shape; broader DTO shapes will use a dedicated copy-and-compare strategy if/when they emerge.
